name: tavily-monitor
description: Build a Tavily search or extraction that runs on a cadence, with a saved baseline. Search monitors set max_age_hours to the interval so a cached copy from before it is not returned. Use when the user wants to monitor, track, watch, or be alerted when something changes, or asks for a recurring check of a query or a page. For a deep comprehensive report use tavily-research. For a one-time lookup use tavily-search. For a one-time table use tavily-list.

findings.excerpt: Use `tavily-search` to run the check. If it isn't installed, run `npx skills add tavily-ai/skills --skill tavily-search` and read its SKILL.md before continuing

- The user wants every current match, once. Use `tavily-list`. If it isn't installed, run `npx skills add tavily-ai/skills --skill tavily-list` and read its SKI
